verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents API keys as personal access tokens that let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses (docs-2). It also has a documented gateway API that exposes workspaces as OpenAI-compatible models any OpenAI-style client can drive (docs-33). The probe found no OpenAPI spec on the docs site, but that only shows no published spec there, not that the API is missing. missing for 10: an evidenced endpoint reference or published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
